moments.author: Ian Rapoport
moments.quote: Steelers G Mason McCormick dislocated his ankle without a fracture; no surgery needed, could return for playoffs.
moments.why: It’s a major NFL injury update reversing season‑ending expectations, giving fans hope.
moments.url: NBC Sports article quoting Rapoport’s post

moments.author: Rockstar Games
moments.quote: GTA VI is now available—praised as a masterpiece and the most believable game world ever.
moments.why: The long‑awaited GTA release is stirring massive cultural buzz across gaming and beyond.

moments.author: Anonymous gamer user reported by news
moments.quote: “We might actually have a real revolution in this country if PlayStation goes down right before the GTA 6 release.”
moments.why: It encapsulates the hyper‑dramatic gamer reaction to major launch‑day server outages.
moments.url: Axios article covering PlayStation outage and gamer backlash

moments.author: Tyreek Hill
moments.quote: It’s almost time to get off the couch and get to work
